research_question: Does a strict read-before-observed-effect, past-match-masked auxiliary prediction loss produce competent conventional GRU/diagonal SSM 256-float factual memory, in the nonstationary numeric action-consequence world where P69 end-query-only GRU/SSM had DEV_FAIL?
hypothesis: On fresh disjoint P75 synthetic FIT/VAL and three sealed OOD-DEV cohorts, matched-source and matched-update read-before-write masked-prequential training produces at least 25% lower validation final-query MSE than zero, and beats same-architecture final-only supervised training by >=10% mean final-query MSE in all 3 model seeds.

source.generator: identical fixed P69 causal-shift generator logic (16D, eight causal roles, four hidden changes, 96 factual events/world), deterministic independent P75 seed namespace and immutable code SHA required before any first-use
source.split_digest: sha256(concatenated per-world action/effect/query/outcome sha256 for ordered indices), computed once on authorized source birth; no tuning to digest

gru.static_weights: fixed same per-seed within pair; independent across seeds

ssm.static_weights: fixed same per-seed within pair; independent across seeds

training.prequential_rule: Predict measured effect for each already executed action a_t using the state after factual events before t and the current action a_t, BEFORE encoder consumes current observed effect y_t. Then train on y_t after it is observed; no future observations/query/hidden roles/change-time available for decision.
training.prequential_mask: For t>0, mark if max abs(cos(a_t,a_i)) over i<t is >=0.85, using ONLY past actually executed actions and current action. Mask is detached and no role labels, phase flags, future query or target-effect magnitude is permitted. If zero matched events in a batch, aux loss=0 exactly.
training.loss_matched_prequential: final_loss + 0.50*mean(mse(prequential_before_write_prediction,actual_effect) over masked events); normalization by masked-event count, fallback zero. Both use same train world and same final action label.
training.validation_selection: Best VAL final-query MSE only (ignore prequential aux in checkpoint selection); plateau/convergence last 3 checkpoints spread <=0.01, and <=0.75*VAL zero-state MSE for conventional competence
training.early_stop: Only >=200 updates and 4 nonimproving checks and converged last-three MSE spread <=0.01; otherwise full 600 updates
training.comparability: Same state floats and optimizer updates and train/val examples; dense auxiliary has extra floating-point operations and supervision from observed historical consequences; report training time/FLOPs/peak RAM separately and do not claim equal compute.

checks_before_any_holdout: P75 FIT/VAL source integrity and cross-split deterministic digest; no index-only shortcut; no exact future-query leakage
Frozen P69 baseline 256-float state shape, no extra recurrent state
Read-before-write numerical equivalence to independent prefix unroll for 3-step and 8-step toy examples (GRU and SSM)
Target effect permutation changes loss but not any prequential prediction at current step
Past-match mask forbids future actions, catches anti-parallel signed repeats, excludes non-repeated distractors and first event
No hidden role/phase/label dependence and no final-query data leakage during encoding
Gradients and exact model-state cold restoration for both architectures
Every candidate GRU/SSM trained validation score <=0.75 * zero in all 3 seeds; if none competent, strict DEV_FAIL and do not generate or score OOD
Any missing exact-head Windows/Linux regression and original build blocks full engineering acceptance and external science

primary_ood_if_admitted.only_if: All source/audit gates, trained competency, exact-source custody, full regression and separately owner-authorized DEV first-use pass
primary_ood_if_admitted.per_seed: prequential <=0.9 * corresponding final-only validation-qualified baseline on each cohort, 9/9 paired comparisons
primary_ood_if_admitted.bootstrap: 5000 paired world-bootstrap relative gain 95pct lower bound>0 in each of 9 comparisons
primary_ood_if_admitted.negative: Shuffled action credit and future-query leakage sentinels fail closed; no retroactive tuning
primary_ood_if_admitted.outcome: Development only; not independently authenticated physics/real-world scientific evidence
